subject: Lloyds Bank, 23 London Street, Southport PR9 0UX
identity: The bank occupies the Anchor Street corner, immediately north of Nationwide 25–27 London Street. The coarse way-371900482-front includes both premises and other frontage; it is not the bank parcel.

coverage.london_street: Google Street View August 2024, panorama DUyBbUxjd1TS33yxw9dI-A. Three arched upper windows above a green fascia, glazed entrance and ATM, pale stone and a rounded corner. Large canopy/cornice on brackets. Visible neighbouring Nationwide has a distinct modern white-clad upper facade.
coverage.anchor_street: Google Street View August 2024, panorama j1tZHV_c9SEYzcJaD0v2Mw. Long pale stone side with a row of upper rectangular sashes and ground glazing; toward the rear a taller arched light above a lower masonry service enclosure with a gated opening. Exact rear parcel division remains uncertain.
coverage.roof: Google actual 3D photogrammetry orbit at headings 0, 92.75 and 190.75 degrees: essentially flat dark roof behind parapet with rectangular rooftop features. The roof continues into neighbouring Nationwide; their apparent physical boundary is estimated from facade change and aerial. No conventional pitched bank roof is supported.
coverage.rear: 3D overhead and oblique views reveal changes in height and nearby rear courts, but the rear wall is occluded; its openings and detailed form are unverified.
coverage.party: The Nationwide party wall is concealed and is not independently observed.
coverage.ground: August 2024 Street View and 3D overhead show the open Anchor Street mouth and rounded pavement corner; dimensions are estimates. The narrow Anchor Street footway, kerb and double yellow lines remain visible along the return.

measurement_inputs.image: Private lloyds-plan.png, Google Maps overhead satellite, accessed 2026-10-26; image 1440x1000 pixels, heading 92.75 degrees.
measurement_inputs.scale: 10 m scale bar approximately 87 pixels, 0.115 m/pixel. Roof corners approximately (740,606), (797,543), (606,474); roof overhang and image registration add uncertainty.
measurement_inputs.frontage: sqrt(57^2+63^2)/87*10 = 9.8 m, provisional ±1 m from roof image and facade boundary.
measurement_inputs.main_depth: sqrt(134^2+132^2)/87*10 = 21.6 m, provisional ±2 m; roof parallax and uncertain rear joint.
measurement_inputs.height: Ground storey approximately 4 m; parapet approximately 10–11 m above pavement, estimated against door and storey proportions. No surveyed elevation is available.

limitations: Bank rear boundary, concealed party wall, rear elevations and exact heights remain estimated.
The represented 2024 signage is a dated state and does not assert current occupancy.
